skirmish.module.navigator.name: Navigator
skirmish.module.navigator.description: GPS for the anarchy: remembers every Nether portal you go through and plans the fastest way to the selected waypoint across the Overworld and the Nether. Route card with steps and ETA, a compass bar, beams over the target and portal, your path of the last hour on the map and a «Home» key (H).
skirmish.module.navigator.setting.compas: A compass strip on top with directions and your waypoints
A card with the route's steps when the way goes through portals
Light beams over waypoints, like a beacon's
skirmish.module.navigator.setting.breadc: Remember where you went in the last hour (shown on the map)
skirmish.module.navigator.setting.home_k: Route to the «Home» waypoint (placed where you stand if missing)
